name: Fantech WG9 Kanata Wireless Gaming Mouse RGB
shortDescription: Fantech WG9 Kanata Wireless Gaming Mouse RGB (2.4GHz Wireless Connection / Huano Silent Switches / Adjustable 2000 DPI Optical Sensor / 600mAh Rechargeable Battery Up to 85 Hours / 6 Programmable Buttons / Dynamic Rainbo
descriptionHtml:
Fantech WG9 Kanata Wireless Gaming Mouse RGB (2.4GHz Wireless Connection / Huano Silent Switches / Adjustable 2000 DPI Optical Sensor / 600mAh Rechargeable Battery Up to 85 Hours / 6 Programmable Buttons / Dynamic Rainbow RGB Lighting / Right-Handed Ergonomic Design / 1-Year Official Agent Warranty)

Experience silent, high-precision wireless execution with the Fantech WG9 Kanata Wireless Gaming Mouse, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year Official Agent Warranty (ضمان سنة من الوكيل). Built for stealthy long-session gaming and productivity, the WG9 Kanata features ultra-quiet Huano Silent switches rated for 5 million clicks, low-latency 2.4GHz wireless connectivity via USB nano receiver, an adjustable Pixart optical sensor up to 2000 DPI, a rechargeable 600mAh battery providing up to 85 hours of continuous battery life, dynamic Rainbow RGB illumination, and dedicated software customization support.
